name: What information goes into a residential floor plan?

mainEntity.name: What information goes into a residential floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Floor plans show room layouts, door/window locations, dimensions, fixtures, circulation paths, and key built-ins, serving as the primary guide for framing and layout.
